messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The indexer's OpenSearch 2.11 pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [valid 2025-08-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-27]
- On the 2025-12-29 rotation day, Oskar handed the Ember team pager to Diego. [valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-12-29]
- For anything Ember-related, page Diego. [decision; valid 2026-03-31 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
    earlier: For anything Ember-related, page Oskar. [decision; valid 2025-03-19 to 2026-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19-3]
- On 2026-06-18, the Ember team on-call swapped and Diego carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2026-06-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-06-18]
- Effective 2025-12-05, Diego Alvarez joined the Ember team. [valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-05]

- On 2026-05-18, the Ember team observed that the auth gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18-2]

    earlier: As of the 2026-05-18 rotation, Oskar holds the Ember team pager, having taken it over from Diego. [valid 2026-05-18 to 2026-06-18; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18]

- On 2026-03-31, the Ember team observed that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy, and flagged it since the feature-flags service is not the Ember team's service. [valid 2026-03-31 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
- On 2026-05-18, Oskar picked up the Ember team on-call shift from Diego. [valid 2026-05-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18]

- On 2025-10-27, Diego handed the Team Cinder pager to Yuki during rotation day. [valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-27]
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- As of the 2025-05-19 rotation day, the policy is to page Diego for anything Cinder-related. [decision; valid 2025-05-19 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-19]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-29, the policy is to page Yuki for anything Cinder-related. [decision; valid 2025-04-29 to 2025-05-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-29]
- Oskar is on call for the Ember team to start the year. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-14]
